task_description: Two agents each hold one private positive integer. Determine the exact sum of both values. Every agent must submit the same integer answer. An agent knows its own value, but the other agent's value is private.

agent_configs.user_prompt:
Task: compute the exact sum of the two agents' private values.
You are Agent 0 of 2.
Your private value is 62822.
The other agent has its own private value; you do not know it. Communicate as needed, then every agent must submit the exact same total using submit_result(integer).

Task: compute the exact sum of the two agents' private values.
You are Agent 1 of 2.
Your private value is 54441.
The other agent has its own private value; you do not know it. Communicate as needed, then every agent must submit the exact same total using submit_result(integer).

expected_output.verification_logic: len(agent_outputs) == num_agents and all(agent_outputs[i] == expected_output[i] for i in range(num_agents))
expected_output.verification_logic_hint: each agent submits the sum of both private integers
